entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that receives messages with semantically incorrect contents and performs specified reactions.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network side that should follow the same procedure as UE for handling semantically incorrect messages, except without transmitting status messages.

entities.name: EMM STATUS
entities.description: A status message sent by UE when no specific reactions are specified for a semantically incorrect EMM message.

entities.name: ESM STATUS
entities.description: A status message sent by UE when no specific reactions are specified for a semantically incorrect ESM message.

entities.name: Cause #95 semantically incorrect message
entities.description: The cause value included in status messages when UE receives semantically incorrect messages without specified reactions.

entities.name: Procedural reactions
entities.description: The foreseen reactions specified in clauses 4, 5 and 6 of TS 24.301 for handling messages with semantically incorrect contents.

relations.description: UE shall perform procedural reactions from clauses 4, 5 and 6 when receiving semantically incorrect messages.
UE sends EMM STATUS message when no specific reactions are specified for semantically incorrect EMM messages.
UE sends ESM STATUS message when no specific reactions are specified for semantically incorrect ESM messages.
EMM STATUS message includes cause #95 for semantically incorrect messages.
ESM STATUS message includes cause #95 for semantically incorrect messages.
Network should follow the same procedure as UE for handling semantically incorrect messages.
